products.name: Aurelia Velvet Sofa
products.tagline: A sculpted sofa with a softly rounded back, sized and dressed to order.
products.lead_time: Made to order in our atelier · delivered in 6–8 weeks
products.description:
Aurelia pairs a low, generous seat with a back that curves into the arms in one continuous line. The kiln-dried hardwood frame is upholstered by hand, then set on slim tapered legs finished with metal ferrules.

Choose its length, cover and finishes here: every change is shown in 3D, priced instantly and saved as a configuration code your designer can reuse.
features: Sculpted by hand | Hardwood frame, webbed seat and hand-tied upholstery built by our atelier.
Sized to your room | From a compact two-seater to a generous four-seater; the arms keep their proportions.
Covers that last | Performance velvets and bouclés tested beyond 50,000 rubs, leathers that age gracefully.

products.name: Lucca Modular Sofa
products.tagline: Compose it element by element, from a compact sofa to a long sectional with a chaise longue.
products.lead_time: Made to order in our atelier · delivered in 6–8 weeks
products.description:
Lucca is a sectional built from separate elements. Choose a left and a right end (a seat with an arm, a chaise longue or an ottoman with an open end) and add up to three 1 or 1.5-seat elements in between.

Every element has a piped two-tier back with its own headrest, a deep integrated seat cushion and slim upholstered arms with a soft armrest on top. The 3D view, price and dimensions follow each change, and the configuration code records the exact layout.
features: Composed element by element | Left end, right end and up to three successive elements, from a compact sofa to a long sectional with a chaise longue.
Tailored details | Piped seams, a separate headrest for every seat and black feet that keep the base visually light.
Four cover collections | Mida weave, Chic Bouclé, Soft Velvet and Rough Leather, each in its own palette.

products.name: Nora Lounge Chair
products.tagline: A compact lounge chair on a sculpted solid-wood frame.
products.lead_time: Made to order · delivered in 4–6 weeks
products.description: Nora wraps a deep, cushioned seat in a single curve of solid wood, joined by hand and finished with discreet metal details. Small enough for a reading corner, generous enough to sink into.
features: Solid-wood frame | Steam-bent and hand-joined, then finished in the wood of your choice.
Upholstered by hand | Covers are cut, piped and fitted individually in our atelier.
Built to be lived with | Removable seat cushion and a 10-year frame guarantee.

products.name: Fiora Porcelain Coffee Table
products.tagline: A 12 mm porcelain slab on a sculpted drum base.
products.lead_time: Cut to order from full-size slabs · delivered in 3–5 weeks
products.description: Fiora shows what large-format porcelain can do as furniture: a slab with the depth of natural marble, but stain-, scratch- and heat-resistant. Each top is cut from a full slab, so the veining runs continuously across the surface.
features: Large-format porcelain | Through-body slabs with the look of natural stone and none of its fragility.
Cut to your shape | Round, oval or rectangular tops, edges eased and polished by hand.
Lives with you | Heat, stain and scratch resistant: no sealing, no coasters required.
